notes: Account overview: Retail analytics and personalization platform powering 200+ enterprise storefronts. Heavy realtime inference for checkout-time recommendations and support chatbots.
Discovery -> Evaluation: met with eng + infra on 2026-01-28. POC kickoff week of 2026-02-01. AE + SE on calls: Maya, Derek. CSM looped for post-prod runbook.
Primary ask: Dedicated capacity that can guarantee 95th-pct latency <=120ms for recommend/chat endpoints while supporting 400-600 concurrent RPS during peak (holiday surges).
Throughput targets discussed: sustained 500 QPS for short-text chat gen (avg 120 tokens) and 250 QPS for long-context scoring (16k windows). Goal is headroom for 2x peak burst for 2-hour windows.

Reserved GPU planning: initial estimate 8x A100-80GB (or 12x A10G depending on cost). SE requested Redwood capacity model to produce cost vs latency curves for A10G/A100/RTX8000. Need capex vs opex comparison for on-prem option.

SLA negotiation points: 99.9% regional uptime target, credits for sustained SLO misses >3 consecutive hours, response <1hr for P1 incidents, quarterly performance reviews. Legal flagged penalty caps and hardware replacement windows.

Model-specific tuning: evaluating Llama-2-70B and mix of open-weights for embeddings. Two tuning tracks: 1) 8k context tuned with int8+4-bit quant profiles for cost savings; 2) 32k context experiments with selective KV cache persistence to reduce cold-start token costs.

Quantization profile notes: prefer validated 4-bit QAT for rec-gen models, but need Redwood guidance on expected perf delta (latency/throughput) and quality regression thresholds. SE asked for recommended fallback to int8 for specific layers if hallucination/regression observed.

Batching & KV cache strategy: target small per-request batching (N=4-8) with dynamic batching windows under 10ms to keep tail latency tight. Plan to enable per-customer KV cache with shard eviction TTL of 30m for session-heavy accounts. Measuring cache hit-rate target >70% for checkout flows.
POC milestones (timeline):
- Week 1: baseline profiling on Redwood hosted with synthetic trace (throughput/95th/99th).
- Week 2: Dedicated staging pool provisioned (4 GPUs), run quant profiles and 8k/32k runs. Capture token-per-second metrics and memory footprint.
- Week 3: Run mixed-workload soak (72h) to validate autoscaling and fallback routing under noise. Collect cost-per-1M tokens estimates.
- Week 4: Executive readout + SLA term-sheet draft. Target decision by 2026-03-05.

Notes from last call (2026-02-12): 'we need hard numbers on 32k latency before we can commit to reserve' — Head of Infra. Also: CTO asks for fallback policy that automatically routes to cheaper model variant on saturation.

Action items assigned: Redwood SE to deliver detailed perf deck (A100 vs A10G) by 2026-02-18; Legal to send redlines on the SLA by 2026-02-20; Amberline infra to provide representative traffic traces (anonymized) by 2026-02-16.
Risks: potential underestimation of KV cache working set leading to higher memory footprint; procurement timeline (internal capital cycle closes mid-April) could push decision into Q2.
Quote from evaluation lead: 'We prefer reserved capacity if Redwood can guarantee tail latency and a clear plan for model fallbacks — otherwise we'll hybridize with self-hosted endpoints.'
Relevant artifacts: perf-run CSVs will live in drive link above; legal SLA draft stored in drive; reference Jira RID-7211 tracks quantization regressions found during early tests.
